relation_to_v1.reason: The NR07 ladder executable bytes are absent (NR07_LUNARC_EXECUTABLE_BYTES_ABSENT), so a faithful replay is impossible. This is a NEW prospective measurement under a NEW protocol identity. The V1 lane remains history and is not reopened or re-adjudicated.

measurement_object.generator: np.random.default_rng([seed, 0, d, s, r]) under committed P11H semantics
measurement_object.feature_bank: all s-subset parity columns in itertools.combinations order; bank width p = C(d, s)
measurement_object.support_rule: keep the top-r features by ABSOLUTE INTEGER correlation with the label stream
measurement_object.tie_semantics: SET-VALUED. At the top-r boundary, enumerate every feature whose absolute integer correlation equals the r-th value. S(x) is the set of all supports consistent with the ordering under every admissible resolution of that equality.
measurement_object.deterministic_secondary_key: ascending feature index within itertools.combinations order. This key is bound HERE, prospectively, and is part of the registered scientific object. It is used ONLY to name a canonical member of S(x); it never replaces reporting the admissible range.
measurement_object.scorer: exact integer count of correct decisions over the ordered (query, test-row) stream; accuracy reported as an exact rational numerator/denominator, never a float aggregate
measurement_object.raw_custody: bit-packed labels and per-candidate predictions retained (little-endian numpy.packbits), with ordered query and test-row ids hash-bound

ladder.rationale: Cells, seeds and size grid are taken unchanged from the authoritative job-3550337 readings so that the reconstruction is comparable. They are frozen here and may not be altered after outcomes are read.

primary_quantities.definition: n_cross(cell) = smallest train size whose 7-seed mean screening accuracy reaches tau

set_valued_form.n_cross_lo: smallest n such that the MAXIMUM over admissible selections of the 7-seed mean is >= tau
set_valued_form.n_cross_hi: smallest n such that the MINIMUM over admissible selections of the 7-seed mean is >= tau

primary_quantities.bounds_are_exact: The per-seed min and max over S(x) are attained independently, so the 7-seed mean bounds are exact, not conservative relaxations.

verdict_evaluation.criteria_source: prereg_criterion of NR07_WIDTH_LAW_FALSIFICATION_RESULT_V1 (C1/C2/C3/C4), reproduced verbatim and NOT modified
verdict_evaluation.rule: Evaluate C1/C2/C3/C4 at n_cross_lo and at n_cross_hi. If they agree for every admissible selection the verdict is invariant; if any two selections disagree the verdict is not identified.

integrity_controls.separable_gap_control: At every reconstructed point whose top-r rank gap IS separable, S(x) must be a singleton. This is a positive control on the enumerator: a separable gap that yields |S| > 1 is an enumerator defect, not a finding.
integrity_controls.no_alarm_control: On a synthetic instance constructed with strictly distinct correlations, the enumerator must report zero ties. Asserted before the ladder is run.
integrity_controls.checker_independence: The independent checker recomputes n_cross_lo/n_cross_hi and the verdict from the emitted raw transcripts alone. It must not import the runner or any generating logic.
integrity_controls.cannot_check_is_distinct: Failure to reconstruct exits with a distinct code and terminal T4; it is never reported as a pass.

execution.host_class: LUNARC compute node (no network egress required; generator is deterministic and local)
execution.resource_accounting: wall-clock seconds, CPU-seconds and peak RSS recorded per cell and in aggregate

authority.maximum_authorized_wording: Under a new prospective protocol that binds set-valued support semantics and an exact integer scorer, the registered primary quantity n_cross is (or is not) point-identified on the reconstructed ladder. This does not re-adjudicate the V1 registered study, does not establish the width law, and does not license any pooled-attack, compiled-defence or P11-gate statement.
